answer.css:
.osce-menu{max-width:48rem;margin:auto;padding:8px;color:var(--text-primary,#1d232a);font:inherit}.osce-menu *{box-sizing:border-box}.osce-menu [hidden]{display:none!important}.osce-menu h1{font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 8px}.osce-menu h2{font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.3;margin:8px 0 3px;color:var(--text-secondary,#505b69)}.osce-menu button{font:inherit;font-size:.82rem!important;line-height:1.25!important;cursor:pointer;min-height:30px!important;padding:4px 5px!important;border:1px solid var(--border-color,#a8afb8)!important;border-radius:2px!important;background:var(--background-primary,#fff);color:inherit}.osce-menu button:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.5}.specialties,#topics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:2px 8px}.osce-menu .specialties button,.osce-menu .condition{text-align:left;border:0!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color,#b8bfc7)!important;border-radius:0!important}.specialties small{float:right;font-size:.7rem;padding-left:4px;opacity:.7}.osce-menu .condition[aria-pressed=true]{background:#1d232a!important;color:#fff!important;font-weight:600}.page-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0 0 6px;font-size:.85rem}.osce-menu #back{border:0!important;padding-left:0!important;font-size:.75rem;text-decoration:underline}.controls{margin-top:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--border-color,#a8afb8);padding-top:6px}.count-label{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600}.osce-menu output{font-size:.95rem}.osce-menu #count{display:block;width:100%;height:30px;min-height:30px!important;margin:0;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;padding:0!important;touch-action:none}.osce-menu #count::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:3px;background:#1d232a}.osce-menu #count::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:20px;height:20px;margin-top:-8px;border:2px solid #1d232a;border-radius:50%;background:#fff}.osce-menu #count::-moz-range-track{height:3px;background:#1d232a}.osce-menu #count::-moz-range-thumb{width:18px;height:18px;border:2px solid #1d232a;border-radius:50%;background:#fff}.run-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.osce-menu #selection{flex:1;font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.25;font-weight:600}.osce-menu #random{border:0!important;text-decoration:underline;font-size:.75rem}.osce-menu #start{min-width:58px;background:#1d232a!important;color:#fff!important;font-weight:600}.osce-menu #status{font-size:.68rem;line-height:1.3;margin:5px 0 0;min-height:1em;color:var(--text-secondary,#505b69)}.osce-menu button:focus-visible,.osce-menu input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:2px}@media(min-width:650px){.specialties,#topics{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
html[data-agora-display="eink"] .osce-menu .condition[aria-pressed=true],html[data-agora-display="eink"] .osce-menu #start{background:#000!important;color:#fff!important}
